# Philips N4520 Player v0.0.15

## Fixed

- Prevented fake VU fallback from continuing to animate while Sendspin is
  connected but waiting for routed audio.
- Changed Sendspin VU calculation from peak-heavy dBFS mapping to a steadier
  RMS-based VU calibration.

## Notes

- With Sendspin enabled, the card now goes quiet until decoded PCM chunks are
  actually received. The status text shows `Sendspin connected, waiting for
  routed audio` when the socket is connected but no playback data is routed to
  the card.
